text: Hello, main ek winter jacket order kiya tha, toh uska tracking status check karna tha. Morning se "out for delivery" dikha raha hai, but abhi 7 PM ho gaye hain aur koi delivery boy nahi aaya. Main poora din ghar pe hi tha, toh lag raha hai ki ya toh app mein kuch galat update ho gaya hai ya phir courier wale ne try hi nahi kiya.
